about: From an early age, I've been drawn to what exists beyond the obvious, constantly seeking new ways to push creative boundaries. I believe that true understanding of both living and technological systems must come before any meaningful creation. I am driven to build innovations that matter, projects rooted in depth, substance, and lasting impact.
